data.title: A name on the rota

memoryNodes.cue: Mr Hale does what he has promised.
Maya has agreed to stay until lunch.
She begins a job that is new to her.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 她开始一项对自己而言陌生的工作。

data.situation:
At the volunteers’ table, Maya met Mr Hale, who had helped at the centre for years. He was dependable: if he promised to open the room, he was there with the key. His loyalty to the group did not mean he agreed with every decision. Last month, he had asked for shorter shifts. Today, he pointed to Maya’s name on the rota and thanked her for making a commitment to stay until lunch. Maya: I do not have much experience at events like this.
Mr Hale: You can begin with the desk. Your personality suits it—you listen before you answer.
Maya: I was afraid I would get everything wrong.
Mr Hale: Nobody expects that. Ask when you are unsure.
His reply was encouraging. Maya put her bag under the table and picked up the visitor list. To Jo
Maya is at the desk until lunch, as agreed. She has asked where to send questions about the exhibits. Please come past the table when you arrive.

readingBlocks.en: At the volunteers’ table, Maya met Mr Hale, who had helped at the centre for years. He was dependable: if he promised to open the room, he was there with the key. His loyalty to the group did not mean he agreed with every decision. Last month, he had asked for shorter shifts. Today, he pointed to Maya’s name on the rota and thanked her for making a commitment to stay until lunch.
readingBlocks.zh: 在志愿者桌边，玛雅见到在中心帮忙多年的黑尔先生。他很可靠：如果答应开门，就会带着钥匙到场。他对团队的忠诚并不意味着赞同所有决定。上个月，他要求缩短班次。今天，他指着排班表上玛雅的名字，感谢她承诺留到午餐。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: I do not have much experience at events like this.
Mr Hale: You can begin with the desk. Your personality suits it—you listen before you answer.
Maya: I was afraid I would get everything wrong.
Mr Hale: Nobody expects that. Ask when you are unsure.
His reply was encouraging. Maya put her bag under the table and picked up the visitor list.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：这样的活动，我没有多少经验。
黑尔先生：你可以先负责前台。你的性格很适合——你会先倾听，再回答。
玛雅：我担心什么都会弄错。
黑尔先生：没人要求你什么都会。拿不准时就问。
他的回答让人受到鼓舞。玛雅把包放到桌下，拿起访客名单。

readingBlocks.en:
To Jo
Maya is at the desk until lunch, as agreed. She has asked where to send questions about the exhibits. Please come past the table when you arrive.
readingBlocks.zh:
致乔
玛雅按约定在前台留到午餐。她问有关展品的问题应该转给谁。你到了请来桌边一趟。

glossary.note: 人或事物值得信赖，强调可依靠。
glossary.example: Mr Hale is dependable; he arrives when he says he will.
glossary.exampleZh: 黑尔先生可靠；他说什么时候来，就什么时候到。

glossary.note: loyalty to someone/something；不等于无条件赞同。
glossary.example: His loyalty to the group has lasted for years.
glossary.exampleZh: 他对团队的忠诚持续了多年。

glossary.note: make a commitment to do something；本批只选承诺义。
glossary.example: Maya made a commitment to stay until lunch.

externalEvidence.definition: a message that makes a pledge

glossary.note: 此处不可数，experience of/in；不是一次经历或动词体验。
glossary.example: Maya has little experience of organising events.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅没有多少组织活动的经验。

externalEvidence.definition: the accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities

glossary.note: 一个人较稳定的性格特点；不是著名人物义。
glossary.example: Her patient personality suits the work at the desk.
glossary.exampleZh: 她耐心的性格适合前台工作。

externalEvidence.definition: the complex of all the attributes--behavioral, temperamental, emotional and mental--that characterize a unique individual

glossary.note: 描述使人有信心或希望的事；人的感受可用encouraged。
glossary.exampleZh: 他的回答令人受到鼓舞。

externalEvidence.definition: giving courage or confidence or hope
